name: Apiro Icons
author: Fakhrul Alam

sections.description:
Apiro Icons integrates a collected set of free icons into the Elementor Icon Picker.

Features

  • Seamless integration into Elementor Icon Library under a single Apiro Icons category tab.
  • Access to over 56,000+ icons (FontAwesome Pro Classic, Sharp, Material, Lucide, Feather, Phosphor, Iconoir, Octicons, and Ionicons).
  • High performance with CDN delivery and Elementor memory caching.

3rd Party Services

By default, this plugin loads icon CSS stylesheets and webfont files from the Apiro Icons CDN (https://free-awesome-icons-cdn.vercel.app).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the apiro-icons directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page in Elementor, edit a widget containing an icon picker, and select from the Apiro Icons tab.
sections.faq:
How do I use the icons in Elementor?

Open any Elementor widget with an Icon control, click the Icon Library, and choose the Apiro Icons tab.

Can I use a custom CDN URL?

Yes! Navigate to Settings > Apiro Icons in your WordPress admin dashboard to set a custom CDN base URL.

  • Fixed Elementor icon picker rendering with JavaScript memory caching patch.
